installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y curl wget unzip git tar ca-certificates jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ashu11-A/Ashu_eggs/main/Connect/all/Jellyfin/start.sh -o start.sh
chmod a+x ./start.sh
./start.sh
